text:
alex (People Ops): Hi @maria — Juliana returned from a 12-week sabbatical and her March 15 paystub shows a PTO lump-sum plus much higher federal withholding than she's used to. Can you check if a supplemental withholding was applied?

maria (Payroll): Sure. Please paste the paystub snippet or last4 SSN and pay period.

alex (People Ops): Snippet (redacted):
```
Gross earnings: $3,600.00
PTO payout: $2,100.00
Federal tax: $1,220.00 (33.2%)
Net pay: $2,030.00
```
Employee: Juliana Park, EmpID 46822, last4 4321, period 03/01-03/15/2026

sam (Eng Manager): Juliana said she logged SB-PTO but didn't opt into any supplemental tax election. She expected normal withholding.

maria (Payroll): @payroll-bot pull payrun for EmpID 46822 period 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-15.

payroll-bot: Pulling payrun... Found record. System applied supplemental flat rate for lump-sum payout AND regular payroll withholding on other earnings, which increased the effective federal percent. Creating internal ticket PAY-5012 for manual review and potential off-cycle reversal.

alex (People Ops): Do we need Juliana's sign-off to run an off-cycle reversal? She asked if we can fix net asap.

maria (Payroll): No employee consent required for correcting a payroll processing error. ETA 2-3 business days after triage. We'll update YTD withholding and document the change on the ticket.

sam (Eng Manager): Will this adjust amounts that go to her W-2? We should preempt questions.

maria (Payroll): Yes. Any correction will update YTD withholding and the W-2 feed. Ticket PAY-5012 includes W-2 impact tracking.

alex (People Ops): I'll let Juliana know and ask for a redacted screenshot if she can share. Please cc me and Sam on ticket updates.

maria (Payroll): Will do.

(reacts: :eyes: from maria, :thumbsup: from sam)
